summary: Adds a workflow that runs Percy visual tests for Dependabot pull requests on pull_request_target, so the job can use PERCY_TOKEN.

findings.title: Untrusted pull request code runs with a repository secret
findings.problem: The job runs on pull_request_target, then checks out the pull request head and runs npm ci and npm run test:visual. Those steps run code from the pull request while PERCY_TOKEN is in the environment.
findings.consequence: Code in the pull request's package.json scripts or test files can read PERCY_TOKEN and send it out. It also runs with base repository context.
findings.fix: Run the visual tests on pull_request and give Dependabot the token through Dependabot secrets. Otherwise, never execute pull request code in a job that holds secrets.

findings.title: Dependabot gate checks the triggering actor instead of the pull request author
findings.problem: The job condition checks github.actor, which names whoever triggered the latest event. It does not name the pull request author.
findings.consequence: An attacker's pull request can pass the gate when Dependabot triggers a synchronize event on the attacker's branch. The attacker's code then runs with PERCY_TOKEN.
findings.fix: Check github.event.pull_request.user.login instead. Also require that the head repository equals the base repository.
